title: Bikini Bottom Vacation Rental
meta_description: Bikini Bottom is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionBikini BottomWaterColor Beach CommunityTall Timber Ct, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights4 bedrooms (see room configurations under the “Room Details” tab)4 bathroomsSleeps up to 12 guests2,700 sq. ft. of indoor living space1,100 sq. ft. of outdoor living spaceOutdoor shower6-seater golf cartGas grillTwo porches, including a screened porch with a large TVParking for 3 vehicles in the drivewayTesla charging stationFour 26" Adult Bikes Included Seasonally (Bikes not included Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Welcome to Bikini BottomWhile not under the sea, Bikini Bottom is perfectly nestled in a quiet, low-traffic section of WaterColor—offering a peaceful retreat just moments from Camp WaterColor, featuring a lazy river and multiple waterslides.A large green space directly in front of the home creates an ideal spot for children to play or for families to relax and enjoy the outdoors. Inside, cathedral ceilings and a chef’s kitchen with luxury appliances—including a Sub-Zero refrigerator and Wolf range—set the stage for an elevated 30A vacation experience.The main home includes a beautifully furnished primary bedroom and two additional king bedrooms. A cozy loft with twin bunks provides a fun space for two children. The separate carriage house offers extra privacy with its own queen bedroom, sleeper sofa, flat-screen TV, and full bath with a shower/tub combo.Conveniently located near the beach, dining, and Publix, Bikini Bottom provides a secluded yet accessible getaway. With generous outdoor space and a family-friendly layout, this home is ideal for families traveling with children.Community AmenitiesWaterColor is known for its eco-friendly design, natural beauty, and world-class amenities. Spend your stay enjoying boutique shopping, excellent dining, outdoor activities, and the community’s many parks and green spaces.Amenities include:Multiple community poolsCamp WaterColorWaterColor Beach ClubPrivate community beach accessWaterColor Town Center (shopping & dining)Access to Western Lake (South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake)Playground, tennis, and pickleballNumerous parks, green spaces, and nature trailsWellness amenities including the WaterColor Boathouse (fees may apply)Guest WristbandsWhen booking, please provide the accurate number of adults and children staying in the home. WaterColor requires wristbands for all guests ages 5 and older for access to pools and beach facilities.We cannot issue wristbands beyond the final confirmed guest count.Changes must be submitted at least two weeks prior to arrival.The HOA strictly limits occupancy to 12 guests and will only issue 12 wristbands per stay.Golf CartsWaterColor restricts golf cart rentals to The Electric Cart Company only. The community permits a limited number of carts (approx. 45 per week). Each home may have only one cart.If your home includes a cart, that fulfills your one allowed cart. For additional rentals or availability, please contact The Electric Cart Company directly.ParkingParking for up to 3 vehicles (two in the driveway, one in front of the garage).Garage access is not permitted for vehicles.Vehicle registration is required prior to arrivalReservation & Booking PoliciesPlease note: The cancellation policy outlined in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement supersedes any terms listed on third-party booking sites (VRBO, HomeAway, etc.). We cannot refund service fees charged by third-party sites.No smokingPublished rates do not include taxes and fees50% deposit due at bookingRemaining balance due 60 days prior to arrival (or in full if booking within 60 days)Aside from a 5% cancellation fee, the initial 50% payment is fully refundable if canceled more than 60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance is available (must be purchased before final payment)Check-in: begins at 4:00 PM CST; Check-out: is 10:00 AM CSTPrimary renter must be at least 25 years old and present for the duration of the stay. Reservations may not be made by or for anyone under 25.
